class.name: IfcLamp
class.brief_description: A lamp is an artificial light source such as a light bulb or tube. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcLamp defines the occurrence of any lamp; common information about lamp types is handled by IfcLampType .
